name: tpl-response-1-goal
task: Whenever you are holding the key, the door must be open at that moment or opened afterwards. Pick up the key, open the door with it, then pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Response(has_door_key, door_open) captures the stated rule that whenever the key is held, the door is open then or later; Existence(target_picked_up) with Precedence(has_door_key, door_open) and Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) captures the commanded order to acquire the key, open the door, then pick up the box. All hard priorities are supported by the task wording, and no redundant existence clause is present.

texts: Whenever the agent is holding the matching door key, the door must be open at that step or at some later step.
The agent must eventually pick up the target box.
The door must not open before the agent has the matching door key.
The target box must not be picked up before the door has opened.
